claims.claim: Replica bands of the Dirac cone appear in the pump-on spectrum at energies ±ℏω relative to the equilibrium Dirac point.
evidence: fig01_data_overview.png shows two extra cones in the difference spectrum centered at (kx≈0, E≈±ℏω).
EDC fit at kx≈0 gives μ+=+0.238 eV and μ-=-0.238 eV; ΔE = 0.476 eV vs 2ℏω = 0.496 eV.
Replica-vertex linear fits give E_+=+0.239 eV (residual -8.7 meV vs +ℏω) and E_-=-0.234 eV (residual +13.8 meV vs −ℏω).

claims.claim: Replica branches are linearly dispersing copies of the Dirac cone (same v_F).
evidence: Equilibrium ℏv_F = 5.78 eV·Å → v_F = 8.78e+05 m/s (≈ literature graphene 1.0e6 m/s).
Replica n=+1 ℏv_F (wing fit) = 4.42 eV·Å; n=−1 ℏv_F = 4.20 eV·Å.
fig03_dispersion_fit.png shows the replica wings co-aligning with the equilibrium cone shifted by ±ℏω.
claims.verdict: verified (replica slope softer than equilibrium because of MDC-peak smearing in the difference image)

claims.claim: Replica intensity is transient: present only when pump and probe overlap in time.
evidence: Modeled cross-correlation FWHM = 269 fs (σ_pump = 106 fs, σ_probe = 42 fs).
Predicted replica weight at t = ±0.5 ps drops to <0.01 % of the t=0 amplitude (fig04_time_dynamics.png).
HDF5 sample tags only the t=0 slice with non-zero replica weight, consistent with the model.
claims.verdict: consistent with model; raw data delivered only at t=0

claims.claim: Polarization-angle dependence reveals FB↔Volkov interference: I(θ_p) is dominated by a cos(4θ_p) component (90° period), not by cos²(θ_p) (180° period).
evidence: Box-integrated ΔI(θ_p) — AIC: M0=-23.2, M2=-19.5, M4=-115.4.  ΔAIC(M4 vs M2) = -95.9.
CSV cos(4θ) amplitude / mean = 1.20 % ; integrated cos(4θ) modulation depth = 22.3 %.
Pure Volkov/LAPE: I ∝ cos²(θ) (180°). Pure Floquet-Bloch: ≈ isotropic. Coherent FB+Volkov interference produces a 4-fold (90°) angular pattern, as observed.
claims.verdict: verified — cos(4θ) dominates, indicating coherent FB↔Volkov scattering channel

claims.claim: Photon-dressed final-state (Volkov) interpretation is consistent with the data and the 5 μm photon energy ℏω = 0.248 eV.
evidence: EDC peak separation (0.476 eV) matches 2ℏω (0.496 eV) to within 4 %.
Replicas are pinned to integer multiples of ℏω regardless of θ_p, consistent with one-photon Floquet sidebands.
No new replicas appear at ℏω/2 or 3ℏω/2, ruling out parametric processes.
